description: Variation of condition 2 of approval 26/00322/FUL to allow increase to footprint and height of outbuilding.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 17th April 2029 which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 26/00322/FUL. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:HD0037-PL01 ; HD0037-PL02RevA; HD0037-PL03RevA; HD0037-PL04RevA; HD0037-PL05RevA; Planning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the use of 90 Ordnance Road, Enfield, EN3 6BW and shall not be used as an independent dwelling, bedroom or sleeping accommodation at any time. Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.
